description: Taiwan's industry value chains from the TPEx Industry Value Chain Information Platform (47 chains such as semiconductors, D000), to find companies by what they do. Without chain: every chain with its code, name and number of companies (all, and TWSE/TPEx-listed). With chain: the chain's segments in platform order (stream upstream, midstream, downstream or another group; sub-segments carry parent_code) with up to `limit` companies each: TWSE and TPEx companies by market cap (latest close times shares issued, calculated by Livermore) with close and change, then emerging-market (ESB) and GISA companies, which have no stock page or quotes. With chain and segment: only that segment and its sub-segments. Unknown codes return an error. Names, streams and listing groups are in Traditional Chinese. The chain data is not government open data (attribution.other_sources); quotes are. tw_get_stock shows the segments of one company. Taiwan conventions: money is in New Taiwan dollars (currency TWD), share counts are in shares (1 lot = 1,000 shares), prices are in TWD and fields ending in _pct are percentages (12.5 means 12.5%). market is TWSE (listed) or TPEx (OTC). Names are in Traditional Chinese, with name_en where available. url links to tw.livermore.club, whose pages are in Traditional Chinese only. Keep `attribution` when you present the data: Taiwan's Open Government Data License requires naming its sources, and fields listed in computed_by_livermore are Livermore's calculations, not official figures.

chain.description: Industry chain code, e.g. D000 (semiconductors). Omit to list every chain.

limit.description: Companies per segment (1-200, default 10), listed companies by market cap first.

segment.description: A segment code within the chain, e.g. D300; returns that segment and its sub-segments. Needs chain.

name: tw_get_industry_chain

attribution.description: Required attribution: Taiwan's Open Government Data License requires naming the sources when you present or pass on this data, and Livermore's own calculations must be kept apart from the official figures.

computed_by_livermore.description: Fields calculated by Livermore from the official data (not published by the sources). Present them as Livermore's calculations, apart from the official figures.

license.description: The license of the data from `sources`; null when no such data was used.

other_sources.description: Sources that are not government open data and not under the license (industry chains).

sources.description: The government open data providers whose data this result uses.

company_count.description: Distinct companies in the chain, including emerging-market (ESB) and GISA companies.

listed_count.description: Of those, TWSE and TPEx companies (which have stock pages).

company_count.description: Distinct companies in the chain, including emerging-market (ESB) and GISA companies.

listed_count.description: Of those, TWSE and TPEx companies (which have stock pages).

chains.description: Every chain, when chain is not given.

currency.description: Every amount of money in this result is in New Taiwan dollars (TWD).

data_date.description: The trading day of the closes and market caps.

listed.description: true for TWSE and TPEx companies; false for ESB and GISA companies (no stock page).

listing_group.description: The platform's group, in Traditional Chinese (domestic listed, foreign OTC...).

anyOf.description: TWSE = listed on the Taiwan Stock Exchange; TPEx = traded on the Taipei Exchange (OTC market).

company_count.description: Companies in this segment itself (sub-segments counted separately).

more_companies.description: Companies in this segment beyond limit.

parent_code.description: The parent segment of a sub-segment.

stream.description: Upstream, midstream, downstream or another group, in Traditional Chinese.

segments.description: The chain's segments in platform order (top-level segments, then their sub-segments), when chain is given.
